ch6_opening.speaker: narrator
ch6_opening.text: Emmanuel wakes before the others. Vestine has not come back with the water she promised. Outside, in the soft earth by the door, there are footprints. Many of them.

ch6_opening.speaker: aline
ch6_opening.text: Emmanuel. I heard voices in the night, outside the house. Men, walking round and round it. And one of them...

ch6_opening.speaker: aline
ch6_opening.text: One of them sounded like Patrick.

ch6_opening.speaker: emmanuel
ch6_opening.text: Keep everyone inside and quiet. I'll look around.

ch6_aline.speaker: aline
ch6_aline.text: Be quick. Every minute we stay here is a minute too long.

ch6_group.speaker: narrator
ch6_group.text: Nobody speaks. Everyone is listening to the path.

ch6_clue_prints.speaker: narrator
ch6_clue_prints.text: Footprints circle the house, right up to the walls. Bare feet and boots. They stood here in the dark and listened, and then they went away to fetch others.

ch6_clue_jug.speaker: narrator
ch6_clue_jug.text: Vestine's water jug lies on its side in the path, the water soaked into the earth. She dropped it and did not come back for it.

ch6_clue_page.speaker: narrator
ch6_clue_page.text: In the trampled grass, a page torn from a notebook. A list of houses, one after another. At the bottom, in fresh ink: 'empty houses by the marsh'.

ch6_clue_page.speaker: emmanuel
ch6_clue_page.text: The same kind of book Gasana told me about. They are still writing things down.

ch6_vestine_early.speaker: narrator
ch6_vestine_early.text: Someone is crying, very quietly, in the long grass.

ch6_vestine.speaker: narrator
ch6_vestine.text: Vestine is curled in the long grass behind the ruined house, her hands over her face.

ch6_vestine.speaker: vestine
ch6_vestine.text: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. They came to my house in the night. They knew I was carrying water to someone.

ch6_vestine.speaker: vestine
ch6_vestine.text: They had my children in the yard. They said if I didn't show them where, my children would be next. So I showed them the path.
ch6_vestine.text_reduced: They threatened my children. So I showed them the path.

ch6_vestine.speaker: vestine
ch6_vestine.text: That doesn't make it right. I know that. I will know it for the rest of my life.

ch6_vestine.speaker: vestine
ch6_vestine.text: I know. I know I did.

ch6_vestine.speaker: vestine
ch6_vestine.text: They are watching my house. If I run, they will know. I have to go back to them.

ch6_vestine.speaker: vestine
ch6_vestine.text: The one who asked me, the one who knew your names, was young. Your age. The others called him Patrick. He went towards the old school.

ch6_vestine.speaker: vestine
ch6_vestine.text: Go. Before the rest of them come back.

ch6_patrick.speaker: narrator
ch6_patrick.text: Patrick is alone on the steps of the old school, a torch still in his hand from the night. He looks as if he has not slept in weeks.

ch6_patrick.speaker: patrick
ch6_patrick.text: Emmanuel. I knew it. I knew you'd be with them.

ch6_patrick.speaker: patrick
ch6_patrick.text: You told me no, that day at the football field. You were the only one who did.

ch6_patrick.speaker: patrick
ch6_patrick.text: You said you would think about it. You never came.

ch6_patrick.speaker: emmanuel
ch6_patrick.text: We grew up together. How can you help them hurt people?

ch6_patrick.speaker: patrick
ch6_patrick.text: You don't understand! They threatened us. They said we'd be next!

ch6_patrick.speaker: emmanuel
ch6_patrick.text: Fear explains what happened to you. It doesn't excuse what you've done to others.

ch6_patrick.speaker: patrick
ch6_patrick.text: What am I supposed to do now?

ch6_patrick.speaker: emmanuel
ch6_patrick.text: Stop hurting people. If you can, help them. Face what you've done.

choices.text: [Turn your back on him and walk away.]

ch6_patrick.speaker: patrick
ch6_patrick.text: I can't promise you anything. I can't even promise myself anything any more.

ch6_patrick.speaker: narrator
ch6_patrick.text: Emmanuel turns his back on him. Behind him, Patrick does not call out.

ch6_patrick.speaker: narrator
ch6_patrick.text: Whistles on the far side of the hamlet. Voices. The search is starting again.

ch6_escape.speaker: aline
ch6_escape.text: They're coming back. Everyone, with Emmanuel. Low, and quiet.

ch6_end.speaker: narrator
ch6_end.text: They run until the voices are far behind them, down through the papyrus, towards the sound of moving water.

ch6_end.speaker: aline
ch6_end.text: Is everyone here? Count them, Emmanuel. Count them again.
